# Browser dependencies

- D3 7.9.0: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js
  Upstream: https://github.com/d3/d3/tree/v7.9.0
  License: ISC, retained in D3-LICENSE.txt. Served locally, not from a runtime CDN.
- Globe coastline: Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons, public domain.
  https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
  Exported from the existing Cartopy cache by scripts/export_site_globe_data.py.

The globe is an original D3/Canvas implementation; no Seasats source code,
textures, vessel models, fonts or route data were copied.
